init.title: fleetassistant options
init.description: Edit the site profile or the HAEO hub options. Leave the profile JSON empty to keep the stored profile.

data.apply_haeo_plan: Write the plan to HAEO now (provisioning)

data_description.relax_impossible_plans: Tells HAEO to return an approximate plan instead of no plan when constraints cannot all be met. Fleet reliability prefers an approximate plan.
data_description.preset_days: Horizon length for systems that plan from a preset. A forecast sensor on a system overrides this.
data_description.apply_haeo_plan: When on, setup provisions the HAEO hub, elements and pricing from the compiled plan. Leave off until the HAEO payloads have been confirmed on a live instance.
data_description.profile_json: Paste a full site profile to replace the stored one. Invalid profiles are rejected and the stored profile is kept.
data_description.price_authority: Which tariff wins when a cloud quote and your own schedule both price an hour. Leave empty to use the deployment profile's default (cloud-primary: cloud, gateway: user).
